urls.rationale: Subchapter 4 - Disclosure by Lobbyists and State and Local Officials - General Provisions; contains the short title, definitions, penalties, investigation procedure, supplemental provisions, and gift / event-ticket / art disclosure rules (§§ 21-8-401 to 407).
Subchapter 5 - Disclosure by Lobbyists and State and Local Officials - Investigation by Attorney General (§ 21-8-501); enforcement provision for the disclosure regime.
Subchapter 6 - Disclosure by Lobbyists; contains lobbyist registration, required filings, activity reports, recordkeeping, and prohibited acts (§§ 21-8-601 to 607).

notes: Subch. 1 (General Provisions, Nepotism / former-employee restrictions §§ 21-8-101 to 104) excluded as out-of-scope per AR 2015 canary precedent. Subch. 2 (income disclosure by salaried employees), Subch. 3 (general code of ethics), Subch. 7-10 (financial-interest, conflict-of-interest, sales-to-state, state-boards) are not lobbying-disclosure scope. Subch. 4/5/6 together constitute the AR lobbying-disclosure regime.
